title: Benowitz photographs an alleged underground alien base at Archuleta Mesa

tellings.quote: He said there, you know, there was an alien base underground at the Archeletta Mesa. He went there with a camera and took pictures

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named Greg Bishop talks about a man called Paul Benowitz, who in the early 1980s said there was an alien base hidden underground at Archuleta Mesa, a flat-topped hill in New Mexico. According to Bishop, Benowitz went there with a camera and took pictures of it. If true, it would mean non-human beings were living and working beneath American soil.
